name: boxdawn-guard
description: Judges each Bash and PowerShell command, and each read of a secret file by name, before Claude runs it: deny, ask, or no decision.

api_key.title: Boxdawn API key (optional)
api_key.description: With a key, the guard fetches signed rule updates from Boxdawn at session start (the request carries the key only). Leave empty to use the fixed rules with no network connection.

keep_blocks_local.title: Keep the block record on this machine
keep_blocks_local.description: On a paid plan the guard sends its block record (tool, deny or ask, rule ids, where the target sits; never a command or a path) to Boxdawn at session start. Turn this on to keep it on this machine only.

keep_secrets_out_of_grep.title: Keep secret files out of grep -r
keep_secrets_out_of_grep.description: Adds --exclude flags to a recursive grep in Bash so it leaves secret files out. Turn this off and no flags are added; a search that starts in a credentials folder still asks.

undo.title: Snapshot the project before each command
undo.description: Before each Bash or PowerShell command the guard saves a copy of the project's files, ignored ones such as .env too, in the plugin's data folder on this machine. Nothing is sent anywhere. `undo list <project folder>` and `undo restore <n> <project folder>`, given to bdxguard.exe in the plugin's data folder (`current`), show the copies and put one back. Windows only for now, and it needs git 2.25 or later; where it cannot work the list says so.Not saved: anything outside the project folder (a database server's data, cloud resources, other folders), the project's own .git folder (commits, stashes, branches), node_modules and similar folders, repositories inside the project, folders that are links, empty folders, files over 50 MB, files that cannot be read. A file changed by an edit tool is saved before the next Bash or PowerShell command. A command that runs before its copy is ready, as in a large project at the start of a session, shows as NO SNAPSHOT in the list and is not protected. While this is on, a Bash or PowerShell command or a Read, Grep, Write or Edit call with a path into the plugin's data folder is denied, even one that only mentions it, and the guard's own `undo restore` asks first. Not seen: a path put together only when the command runs, a link that already leads there, and what a script does once it runs.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the guard's messages. Auto follows this machine's language.
